about.title: About Reed Title Company
text: Reed Title Company headquartered in Spring, Texas is a leading provider of title insurance services. Reed Title currently operates multiple locations in the Houston Metropolitan area and is licensed to operate in 38 counties in Texas. We are local, we are independent, and we know Texas. Reed Title Company believes it is crucial to be local. Our strength lies in collective wisdom, industry insight, and a company of resources with experience embedded in local knowledge.
